items.name: Nacionales Argentinas 2022
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajRlIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c3b082f2d822b4c657106bb42a586dcdbd30e6c/argy%20i.png) Las Nacionales Argentinas 2022 serán la tercera edición del Campeonato Nacional Argentino, el cual tomará lugar en la ciudad de Santa Fe. Constará de tres días y se podrá competir en 17 categorías distintas. Recomendamos leer todos los apartados de la página para resolver sus dudas y evitar inconvenientes; para consultas puntuales, contactar al equipo organizador. Rogamos puntualidad y recomendamos llegar al menos 15 minutos antes de cualquier categoría en la que se vaya a participar. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBajhlIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--a9b158f6d0648889ba19a4a7b66cf5fe51d59c87/uk%202.png) Nacionales Argentinas 2022 will be the third edition of Argentinian National Championship. It will be held in the span of three days and it will feature all seventeen WCA events. We recommend reading each and every section of this page in order to avoid inconveniences; for any specific doubts or questions, please contact the organization team. We ask for punctuality and recommend competitors to arrive at least 15 minutes before any event in which they wish to participate.

items.name: Nigeria Championship 2022
items.information: Shared route From Jibowu Bus Stop to Igbobi College Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria. via Ikorodu-Ososun Rd and Bajulaye Rd/Morocco Rd. 6 min (1.9 km) 6 min in current traffic 1. Head south on Ikorodu-Ososun Rd toward Murtala Muhammed Way/Murtala Muhammed Bridge 2. Make a U-turn at Edmund Cres/Empire Rd/Higer College Rd/Moshalashi Rd 3. Turn right onto Jibowu St 4. Turn left onto Alakija St 5. At the roundabout, take the 1st exit onto Bajulaye Rd/Igbobi College Rd/Morocco Rd 6. Turn left onto Igbobi College Access Rd 7. Arrive at location: Igbobi College Yaba, Lagos, Nigeria. For the best route in current traffic visit https://maps.app.goo.gl/bYemqvHpDyxGPqWX8

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/YoWZNDt.png) **COVID-19 Safety Measures** All registrants will be required to adhere to all COVID-19 health and safety measures while at the competition venue. **Volunteering** We will need your help as volunteers to support with the running and judging of the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the [organisers](https://africanchamps.thecubinghub.com/google-forms/). Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing. **Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of Rubik's WCA African Championship 2022 consent to their images being used by the World Cube Association and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms.

items.information: ![West Coast Cubing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png) - This competition is in partnership with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) - The WCC Western Championship 2022 will be held in Los Angeles, California, on October 7-9, 2022. Featuring 17 different events, Speedcubers from the CubingUSA-recognized West region of Arizona, California, Colorado, Hawaii, Nevada, and Utah will be eligibile for the title of Western Champion! - Bruin Reception Room shares the same address as Ackerman Ballroom, and we will provide signs and undisclosed details for competitors prior and day-of competition. **- Registration for current UCLA students and faculty is free. If you are UCLA affiliated, register and send the organization team a picture of your current student ID. We will then manually approve your registration.** ***Our schedule is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.***
